name: elevation (eio)
role: Python library and `eio` CLI that fetch, cache and clip global DEM data to a GeoTIFF for bounds
summary: Python package with the `eio` CLI: `eio clip --bounds left bottom right top -o dem.tif` downloads and caches global DEM data (Terrain Tiles MAPZEN default, Copernicus GLO-30/90, ALOS AW3D30, SRTM 30/90 m, GEDTM30) and clips it to a GeoTIFF in EPSG:4326. It needs GDAL's command-line tools and the network on first use; it gives heights, not relief rendering.
use_when: Get a DEM GeoTIFF for a lat/lon box as the first step of a terrain or relief-map scene
Over hand-downloading tiles when bounds are known and the result must be scripted
avoid_when: Hillshading, reprojection or other raster processing of the DEM: GDAL
Rendering map tiles or styles: maplibre-native
Offline work on first run: tiles download on demand

install.macos: micromamba create -p env -c conda-forge python=3.12 gdal && env/bin/pip install elevation==2.1.0

notes: 2026-11-27: the lead said `brew install gdal && uv tool install elevation`; Homebrew gdal failed to install here, so the fixture uses conda-forge gdal. PyPI lists no licence field; Apache-2.0 is from the GitHub repository.

2026-11-27: datasets have provider terms (STAC `license: other`); SRTM3 forbids redistribution and resale without CIAT permission. GLO-30 and GLO-90 need an Earth Data Hub key in ~/.netrc and were not tried.
2026-11-27: PyPI shows 1.1.3 in 2021, then 1.1.4 on 2026-09-30 and 2.0.0 on 2026-10-21: a revival after five years, so the maintenance record is short.

assessment.rationale: PyPI 2.1.0 uploaded 2026-11-09, repository pushed 2026-11-15, not archived, Apache-2.0, 9 open issues. Nothing catalogued fetches elevation data; GDAL (onboarded separately) processes it but does not download it. Data hosts' terms apply.

evidence.result: 8 checks pass, repeat runs identical: clip of -4.12 53.04 -4.03 53.10 (Snowdon) gives a 325x217 EPSG:4326 GeoTIFF, bounds -4.120139 53.039861 -4.029861 53.100139, max 1064 m at -4.07667 53.06833 (summit 1085 m), min 60 m, no nodata. GDAL 3.13.3, Python 3.12.
evidence.scope: MAPZEN clip of one box to GeoTIFF: CRS, bounds, size, summit height; not GLO, SRTM3 or other products, large areas, vertical accuracy elsewhere or rendering; macOS arm64.
